name: Script Runner
description: Run your own PowerShell, Python or Bash scripts from the desktop and see the exit code, time and output. Scripts are the commands declared in widget.json; you approve each one once.
author: AmineChr54

commands.description: Example: prints the Windows version, uptime and free memory.

run: Get-PSDrive -PSProvider FileSystem | Where-Object { $_.Used -ne $null } | ForEach-Object { "{0}: {1:N1} GB free of {2:N1} GB" -f $_.Name, ($_.Free/1GB), (($_.Used+$_.Free)/1GB) }
commands.description: Example: free space on each drive.

run: import sys, platform; print('Python', platform.python_version()); print(sys.executable)
commands.description: Example: needs Python on PATH. Replace it with your own script.

autoScript.label: Script to run automatically (id)
autoScript.hint: The id of a command in widget.json, e.g. disk-free. Leave empty for button only. It only repeats on its own after you have run and approved it with the button.

runOnStart.label: Also run it when the widget starts

bigLine.label: Show the last output line big
bigLine.hint: For one-number dashboards: the last non-empty line of stdout becomes the headline.
